statements.excerpt: "banning Wall Street hedge-funds from buying single family homes" ... "Create tax rebates for young Iowans who stay or return to Iowa for down payment assistance for home ownership."
statements.notes: Hedge-fund ban confirmed. The site says 'tax rebates ... for down payment assistance'. It does not say 'income tax abatement ... deposited into a down payment account'.

statements.exactWording: File antitrust suits against the big agricultural input companies that have formed monopolies and are extorting our farmers.
statements.notes: Quote is verbatim. 'More funding for the Attorney General' is not on the page.

statements.excerpt: "Confiscate any land illegally owned by China and sell that land back to young families and veterans." "Lower property taxes for Iowans by raising property tax rates on Wall Street institutional investors."

statements.exactWording: Give incentives to our farmers to use proven solutions that address agricultural runoff and water contamination.
statements.notes: Deep-banding, buffer strips and monitoring are not on the site. ICD 2026-05-19 partly supports the credits: Lahn wants to 'incentivize different types of nitrogen application' through refundable tax credits for best practices.

statements.exactWording: The Governor Must Be The #1 Advocate For Public School Kids
statements.excerpt: Focus on making public schools so good they are competing with private schools.
"Requiring annual audits of the private school voucher program" ... "Limiting tuition increases" ... "Implementing income limits" ... ending deals like the Odyssey contract.

Restore authority after the 2023 law letting agencies "hide key documents from the Auditor's Office"; make PIE "mandatory for all government agencies"; extend whistleblower protections to "every Iowan."

"make it easier to build more homes ... like duplexes, quadplexes, and ADUs"; "simplifying the permitting and inspections process"; make "downpayment assistance for first-time homebuyers interest-free"
"an income tax credit to help cover the costs of conservation practices, and a property tax credit per acre for farms using approved nutrient plans"; "Establish a dirty water notification system"
statements.notes: Confirmed: monitoring funding, both tax credits, transparent manure plans ('trust, but verify'), digesters, wetlands and the dirty-water alert. IWILL / Natural Resources Trust Fund funding is NOT on this page.

statements.exactWording: As governor, I will end these tax breaks and make sure we're putting the needs of Iowa taxpayers, not major corporations, first.
statements.excerpt: "pay their own way, including covering any increase in costs on utilities" ... "I'd block the use of NDAs on new data centers"

statements.exactWording: The idea that you would have your private property taken just because there's someone who thinks they can put it to better use, but it's not for public use, doesn't sit right with me
statements.notes: KCAU story (2026-10-08), read via Yahoo syndication.

statements.exactWording: I've been very clear that we're not going to use eminent domain for private gain, and so we'll see what the exact options are for that, and what the legality is of that ... I think I can work with the Republican legislature and the House and Senate and get that done.
statements.notes: The research quote is an accurate excerpt. Context: Lahn says he is against eminent domain for private gain.

statements.exactWording: I don't think the government would do a good job of delivering healthcare for the people of Iowa. I think that the private sector can do a great job delivering this, but the government has to hold them accountable. We have to make sure we're getting the right care, proper payment, and also I will not allow any of these companies to use AI in denying coverage from people.
statements.notes: The research's ellipsis leaves out two intervening sentences, but the meaning is preserved.

statements.exactWording: Conduct independent state safety tests on products used in Iowa.

statements.exactWording: We will ban benefits for illegal immigrants, and stop issuing H1B visas for jobs that Iowans can do in state government and in our universities.

statements.notes: MISATTRIBUTION: the quote is NOT in ICD 2026-05-19. It is verbatim on zachlahn.com/policy. The contractor-disclosure and H-1B points ARE in ICD 5/19.

statements.exactWording: You don't just flip the switch and say now it's $12. You have to take a few years to put it in there
Lahn wouldn't commit to raise the minimum wage, which was last raised in Iowa in 2009 and is at $7.25 an hour.
statements.notes: NBC's paraphrase. Side note: NBC says 2009, but other outlets say 2008. Iowa's $7.25 took effect Jan 1, 2008.
